image_description: A close-up view of a Brown Pelican swimming in blue water. The bird is facing left, with its head and neck clearly visible above the waterline. The distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is prominent. The plumage shows a mix of white, grey, and brown feathers on the neck and body. A reflection of the pelican's head and neck is visible in the water below.
